issues.description: Owner agent-e: Rewrite to the mandatory brief output contract; this summary has 3 quantitative result objects (maximum 2) and 7 beginner concepts (allowed 3–5).

Owner agent-e: Numeric statements outside claim/result objects, including evaluation.setting and other free-text fields, lack source IDs and page/section/figure/table locators. Audit every number and move each retained value into a sourced claim/result or remove it.

Owner agent-b: Remove new-system, deployment-experience, and production-deployment. Cloudscape is an empirical study and released dataset built from public architecture videos, not a deployed storage system.

Owner agent-e: Correct evaluation.baselines. Stack Overflow tag frequencies, DeathStarBench, vHive-serverless, and FunctionBench are contextual datasets or workload suites used for comparison/coverage, not experimental baselines.

Owner agent-e: Correct the quantitative locators. The service-prevalence evidence points to Figure 4, not Figure 3; the 52.35% value is derived from Table 3(a) and the 35.3% value is in Table 3(c), not Table 2.

notes: Reopened the official USENIX paper page and PDF; checked metadata, relevance, mechanism, assumptions, evaluation, baselines, every numeric claim and locator, and limitations.
Checked official group/faculty evidence, FAST 2025 awards, repository-wide duplicate titles, and stored link targets.
Open ERROR findings are routed to the owning stage agent; source-stage files were not modified.
